_comment: Maps garment lines to Easify option sets. Sets are located in option-sets.csv by option_set_title; set ids live in the CSV only. A set listed here but absent from the CSV is created on the next sync, cloned structurally from clone_from. REBOUND 16 Sep 2026 from the retiring Printify garments (cc1717, cc1566, cc1567) to their Tapstitch replacements (tee, crew, hoodie). cc1717-dated stays because the dated tee is paused, not replaced. WHY THIS IS LOAD-BEARING: live_temple_products() matches a live product to a set by EXACT EQUALITY against build_title(load_garment_config(garment), ...). While crew.json and cc1566.json shared a title this binding did not matter; renaming the lines to Cloud on 16 Sep made it matter, and left unchanged it would have detached the Temple dropdown from every replacement on the next import, silently. NOTE ON RUNNING THE SYNC MID-MIGRATION: it cannot be run while the store is dark. A populated set whose garment has no live products raises SystemExit by design, which is the guard against blanking a set on a bad catalogue read. Run the sync once enough replacements are live, which is also when it repoints every row's URL to the new addresses.
